race.comment: SPIRITS BURN DEEP (10) tough old mare holding her form and looks due for a change of luck. Sat on the speed when run down late for a courageous second over 1200m at Coffs Harbour in BM93 class.  Among the top three hopes with McColm's claim. CONSTELLATION (7) pushed forward and went on to record a determined win last start over 1125m at this track. Maps well and expected to measure up in this stronger grade. WARRIOR BAE (6) consistent gelding deep into the prep and has to overcome the sticky gate today. Gave his all when racing on the pace to secure third over 1200m at the Gold Coast. Each way contender. HUMPHREE BEAR (4) slow into stride before savaging the line from last on the turn for a tidy third over 1000m at Coffs Harbour. Back in great shape and should have little problem running the 1200m.
